caption: The video captures a tranquil lakeside landscape held in a fixed wide shot. A row of slender green trees stands along a grassy embankment, with layered blue-grey mountains and a band of low clouds rising behind them. The calm water filling the foreground mirrors the trees and sky in soft, elongated reflections. Across the excerpt, the water surface carries a continuous, subtle rippling, so the mirrored tree shapes waver and deform gently from frame to frame. The ripples shift and re-form without any visible start or stop, indicating the motion is already underway when the clip begins and persists through its final frame. The trees, grassy bank, mountains, and clouds remain fixed in position, and the framing shows no pan, tilt, or zoom. The composition stays steady while only the reflection texture changes.
relations: Continuous subtle rippling on the water surface causes the mirrored tree shapes to waver and deform gently.
Shifting and re-forming ripples change the reflection texture without a visible start or stop.
Fixed positions of trees, mountains, and clouds keep the overall composition steady while the water moves.
